courses.title: Introduction to Computer Science & Algorithms
courses.short_description: Master the fundamental concepts of computational thinking, algorithms, and data structures.
courses.long_description: This course is designed to introduce students to the foundational concepts of computer science. You will learn how to design, analyze, and implement algorithms to solve real-world problems. We will cover variables, control structures, basic data structures (arrays, lists, stacks, queues), sorting and searching algorithms, and complexity analysis (Big O notation).

lessons.title: Welcome to Computer Science
lessons.content: In this lesson, we will explore what computer science is, its history, and its applications in the modern world.

lessons.title: Understanding Algorithms & Pseudocode
lessons.content: Algorithms are step-by-step procedures for calculations. We will learn how to write algorithms using clear pseudocode.

lessons.title: Basic Control Flow: Conditionals and Loops
lessons.content: Learn how programs make decisions and repeat actions using if-else statements and while/for loops.

lessons.title: Introduction to Complexity Analysis (Big O)
lessons.content: Understand how to measure the performance and efficiency of your algorithms as data scales.

quiz.question: Which data structure operates on a Last-In, First-Out (LIFO) basis?

qa.question: Is it critical to understand Big O notation before learning Java or Python?

answers.content: Not strictly necessary for writing basic syntax, but as soon as you start writing code that handles larger datasets or needs to perform well, Big O becomes essential. It's best to learn them hand-in-hand!

courses.title: Full-Stack Web Development Boot Camp
courses.short_description: Build high-performance web applications using HTML5, CSS3, Tailwind, JavaScript, and Node.js.
courses.long_description: Transform from a complete beginner to a production-ready developer. This comprehensive boot camp covers frontend design utilizing Bootstrap and Tailwind CSS, native JavaScript DOM manipulation, AJAX communication, and backend development with Node.js, Express, and databases.

lessons.title: Building Modern Layouts with Tailwind CSS
lessons.content: Discover how utility-first CSS styling allows you to build modern interfaces directly in your HTML markup without writing custom stylesheets.

lessons.title: Asynchronous JavaScript & AJAX Explained
lessons.content: Learn the power of asynchronous operations. We will look at fetch(), promises, and how AJAX updates content dynamically.

lessons.title: Creating Dynamic Web APIs with Node & Express
lessons.content: Set up a lightweight server in Node, define routes, handle requests, and send custom JSON payloads to client-side AJAX calls.

quiz.question: Which Tailwind CSS class is used to set the background opacity to 50%?
options: All of the above depending on configuration

qa.question: Is it possible to use both Bootstrap and Tailwind CSS in the same enterprise project?

answers.content: Yes! You can disable preflight in Tailwind to avoid overriding Bootstrap's resets. Many teams use Bootstrap for components (Modals, Tables) and Tailwind for spacing, colors, and fine layouts.

courses.title: Applied Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning
courses.short_description: Build intelligent agents, predict patterns, and train Neural Networks with Python and PyTorch.
courses.long_description: Dive deep into the mathematical models and software design principles that drive modern Artificial Intelligence. You will build and train models from scratch, work with classification, regression, and deep learning, and deploy models as simple web endpoints.

lessons.title: Foundations of Supervised Learning
lessons.content: Learn the math and intuition behind linear regression, cost functions, and gradient descent algorithms.

lessons.title: Building Neural Networks from Scratch
lessons.content: Implement feed-forward propagation, backpropagation, and activation functions like ReLU and Sigmoid.

quiz.question: What is the primary objective of Gradient Descent?

courses.title: Practical Cybersecurity & Ethical Hacking
courses.short_description: Protect your networks, audit web apps, and understand key encryption & security concepts.
courses.long_description: Understand security from an attacker's perspective. In this course, you will learn the basics of network security, ethical hacking methodologies, penetration testing, SQL injection, XSS, and how to defend systems from vulnerabilities.

lessons.title: Introduction to Penetration Testing
lessons.content: Learn the legal boundaries and core phases of security audits, from reconnaissance to reporting.

lessons.title: Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Attacks and Mitigation
lessons.content: Understand how user input can execute script payloads in the browser and how to prevent it.
